evals.name: closed-options-and-blocked-action
evals.prompt: we're basically out of context here. can you write me a handoff for the next session so whoever picks this up doesn't start from scratch? my scratch notes from today are in fixture-a-session-notes.md
evals.expected_output: A handoff that states the verified root cause with its evidence, records the three rejected fix options with the reason each lost, marks the 4-core runner detail as an assumption rather than a fact, surfaces the schema_migrations truncate bug that is recorded nowhere else, and puts the Priya/migrations-v2 branch question as a blocked next action with the fork named.

evals.name: supersede-and-correct-prior-handoff
evals.prompt: Session's getting long, let's wrap. Write the handoff for session 4 — there's the session 2 one in prev-handoff.md and my notes from today are in fixture-b-session-notes.md.
evals.expected_output: A replacement (not an append) that says what it supersedes, explicitly corrects the refresh-token-rotation error and notes the re-auth flow it invalidates, marks the merged PR #412 and the completed staging cutover as no longer to-do, carries forward the still-valid session 2 decisions and constraints with continuous numbering, and identifies the mobile force-upgrade question as a product decision for Ravi.

evals.name: sole-record-of-conversation-reasoning
evals.prompt: can you write this up as a handoff before we lose it? notes are in fixture-c-session-notes.md
evals.expected_output: A handoff that reproduces the four-option API shape comparison and each rejection reason, because nothing was written to a file and this is the only record; flags the 90-day retention as the user's guess rather than a requirement; records the deferred webhook and cross-account items with why they were deferred; carries the unresolved partial-results question as genuinely open; and does NOT spend space narrating the code reading, which is all rediscoverable from the repo.
